nodes.name: Get Product API
nodes.notes: Endpoint /api/webhook/products sudah tanpa pagination (semua produk 1x hit). Credential 'Header Auth': Name: Authorization, Value: Bearer <PRODUCT_WEBHOOK_SECRET> dari .env backend. Secret hanya tersimpan di n8n credential store.

nodes.name: Generate Recipe - MiniMax
nodes.notes: Pattern ContextGenerationService: endpoint = base_url + /v1/chat/completions. Header Authorization: Bearer <SUMOPOD_API_KEY> via credential Header Auth; Content-Type: application/json otomatis dari n8n (JSON body). Payload: model + stream:false + messages (tanpa temperature/max_tokens). Timeout 120s + retry 2x @1s mirip Http::timeout(120)->retry(2,1000).
